results.name: Private Docker preparation succeeds without an engine
Docker endpoints are separate from existing PC databases
Redis ACL stores a hash of its password
Official Docker Compose validates the configuration
Official PostgreSQL and Redis versions are explicit
Every published database port binds loopback
Both services keep their data in named volumes
Rendered Compose contains only secret file references
Healthchecks authenticate as the application database role and Redis client
Mismatched secrets fail without rotating passwords or rewriting files
